_meta.purpose: Follow-up source link and duplicate investigation based on source batch archives plus live public original-directory references
_meta.cruising_spot_rule: Same park, building, beach or road is not proof of same cruising spot; retain distinct reported sections until verified identical
_meta.count_note: Earlier '21 duplicates' and '20 source-page problems' were rough keyword-screen counts, not 21 confirmed duplicate pairs or 20 permanently broken links.

source_page_issue_types.meaning: Web service returned HTTP 451/access restriction; not proven deleted listing.
Research fetch could not retrieve original detail in that attempt; original directory may still list it.
Source page was blocked or unavailable to that researcher; not proof of permanent 404/deletion.
Archived title, URL target or geographical slug did not reconcile; identity/link needs validation, not necessarily broken URL.

verification_summary: Two distinct source directory listings, different access/subareas or 0.5km/0.7km source distance are evidence AGAINST automatic merges, not definitive proof they cannot overlap. No exact identical site pin or same unique original URL was verified for candidate pairs. All original proposal ids remain intact.
